messages:
alejandra: opened PR to update console observability docs -> migrating dashboard example JSON + tracing hook snippets to SDK v2. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2199 :clipboard:

alejandra: also rewrote the cost/latency section to reference our billing metric `token_units` and included a short example output. preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2199 :eyes:

nate: nice. can someone check mobile rendering? legend overflowed last migration.

sam: i'll do responsive pass. did you keep old metric keys for compatibility?

alejandra: yep, backward-compatible keys kept; added migration note about new `cost_key` used for the breakdown widget.

docs-bot: link check -> /sdk/node/tracing was redirected in branch. build passed.

lucy: legal nit: change "per-token" to `token_units` in copy. I'll update the wording.

sam: node snippet still uses old tracing API. suggest switching to `Tracing.start("name", {attrs})`. I'll push a patch.

alejandra: thanks, assigning sam as reviewer.

sam: added snippet fix and suggested python context-manager example: ```python
with Tracing.span("handle_request") as span:
    span.set_attribute("route", "/generate")
```

nate: for the legend on small viewports, prefer a toggle to preserve chart area; ensure ARIA label.

sam: added `{"legend": {"mode": "toggle", "ariaLabel": "Toggle legend"}}` to widget JSON and tested locally.

docs-bot: preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2199  all checks green.

alejandra: final checklist: responsive legend (nate), snippets use SDK v2 (sam), copy uses `token_units` (lucy), redirects in branch (docs-bot). Anyone object to merging after e2e?

nate: go ahead if staging e2e passes.

lucy: wording fixed. good from legal.

sam: e2e pass on staging; one tiny spacing fix at 360px, pushed.

alejandra: merging now. will monitor metrics and open a rollback ticket if anything odd shows up. thanks team! :tada:
